decision.reason: Reuters 13 October reports approximately 400 scientists asking for AI model containment and incident-reporting oversight; voluntary proposal creates auditable preparedness work, not an enacted mandate.

opportunities.core_job: Prepare and audit voluntary frontier-model containment control evidence prior to any future binding standards
opportunities.target_customer: Frontier AI lab safety and assurance program coordinators
opportunities.product_mechanism: Manual isolation architecture register, model access and red-team exception log, independent reviewer signoff and date-stamped incident workflow; never deploys or tests high-risk models
opportunities.why_now: Reuters 13 October documented a scientists' open letter calling for international body and air-gapped AI containment/incident standards, currently a proposal.
opportunities.before_state: Containment control evidence and reviewer signoff scattered across risk files.
opportunities.after_state: Voluntary containment readiness dossier with clearly non-binding policy status.
opportunities.source_verification: primary or original article web-read, downstream qualification pending
